newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 13.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China's regulators have punished a string of listed firms and brokerages including the Shenzhen Development Bank and Shenyin & Wanguo Securities for illegal trading on the stock markets.
- The Shenzhen stock exchange has decided to suspend trading in shares of Shenzhen Development Bank for five trading days after Beijing punished the firm for illegal trading in its own shares.
- BUSINESS NEWS - U.S. car giant General Motors on Thursday formally started work on its huge Shanghai plant to make mid-sized sedans.
